name: Boeing 747-400
summary: The best-selling 747: a two-crew glass cockpit, winglets and a stretched upper deck. It carried most of the world’s long-haul traffic for two decades.

specs.engine_type: GE CF6-80C2B1F, PW4056 or RR RB211-524G/H

asset.author: Gijs de Rooy and the 747-400 contributors

verify.note: The FlightGear model measures 19.98 m tall against the published 19.41 m.

quality.reason: The FlightGear 747-400 models its gear legs and doors untextured white; the legs of the real aircraft are painted light grey.
